title: Heteroatomic molecules for coordination engineering towards advanced Pb-free Sn-based perovskite photovoltaics
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00838C, Review Article
Weiyin Gao, Rui Huang, He Dong, Wangyue Li, Zhongbin Wu, Yonghua Chen, Chenxin Ran
Coordination engineering via developing various heteroatomic molecules has enabled Sn-based perovskite solar cells with efficiency approaching 16% and robust stability. This review summarizes the fundamentals, advances, and prospects of this topic.
